description: Independent cybersecurity audit and resilience testing proposal for a multi-state healthcare provider.
provenance: Modeled on professional-services engagement proposals for healthcare security assurance: threat context, audit scope, control framework, maturity target, workplan, deliverables, team, fees, and independence terms. Deliberately exercises an eight-slide deck with a two-series maturity bar chart, HIPAA-specific language, and fixed-fee milestone detail.

document.presentationTitle: Cybersecurity Audit and Resilience Engagement — North Valley Care

content.title: Cybersecurity Audit & Resilience Engagement
content.subtitle: Prepared for North Valley Care | October 6, 2026 | Engagement proposal KRP-4472

content.title: Independent testing will prove North Valley's ransomware resilience.
content.subtitle: Engagement objective
prose: Scope covers 12 hospitals, the EHR, 94 ambulatory sites, and two laboratories.
Critical patient-care vendors are included in the evidence review.
Keystone tests controls and recovery without disrupting production.

content.title: Engagement coverage
content.subtitle: Evidence-based testing across governance, technology, and clinical operations

content.title: Audit will validate the path to the board's FY2027 maturity target
content.subtitle: Preliminary self-assessment versus target maturity on a five-point scale

content.title: Audit scope — assurance plus technical proof
content.subtitle: Each domain combines document review, interviews, sampling, and direct validation

content.title: Twelve-week workplan and deliverables
content.subtitle: Work begins November 2, 2026; final board report January 29, 2027
bulletPoints: Weeks 1-2 — kickoff, evidence request, asset and vendor scope validation, and audit sampling plan
Weeks 3-6 — control walkthroughs, evidence testing, identity analytics, configuration review, and safe technical validation
Weeks 7-8 — hospital visits at North Valley Central and Riverside; clinical downtime and biomedical-device review
Weeks 9-10 — ransomware recovery exercise, executive tabletop, and preliminary finding validation
Week 11 — management fact-check, severity calibration, root-cause analysis, and remediation workshops
Week 12 — audit opinion, board report, prioritized roadmap, evidence archive, and executive readout

content.title: Team, independence, and investment
content.subtitle: Fixed-fee engagement under North Valley's professional-services terms
bulletPoints: Engagement partner: former health-system CISO; accountable for opinion quality and board presentation
Core team: audit director, cloud security lead, identity specialist, clinical resilience lead, and three senior assessors
Fixed professional fee — $685,000 including travel, technical testing, exercise facilitation, and final board presentation
Optional external penetration test — $118,000; executed only after written authorization and agreed rules of engagement
Keystone has performed no implementation work for North Valley and holds no reseller or referral relationships with its vendors
Business associate agreement, cyber insurance certificate, and evidence-handling protocol included with the draft engagement letter

content.title: Execute by October 23 for a January board report.
content.subtitle: Next steps
prose: Keystone issues the evidence request within two business days.
Scope sessions cover Security, IT, Clinical Engineering, Compliance, Audit, and Risk.
